title: WebSocket /v2/realtime — app <-> 입출구 서버 (BE API spec 2026-10-13, FE 연동 명세)
description: One connection per measurement (purpose measure). Posture registration is B1 POST /v2/baselines only; WebSocket registration (purpose calibration) was removed on 2026-10-27. The first app message is hello. No reconnection (ADR 0024). Messages are connection-scoped, so only hello and ready name the session, plus session_rollover, which moves the connection to a new server-made session at KST midnight (BE-6 1, plan B).

hello.description: app -> server, first message, after PUT /v2/sessions/{id} succeeded (200). access_token: the login access token (JWT) from login/refresh (ADR 0031); checked once, so it may expire during the connection.

features.description: app -> server. Coordinate intervals in sequence order. The server allows 1-30; the app sends one interval holding one frame per message, ending when the next frame arrives, or after 0.5 s without one (FE decision 2026-10-27, FE spec 5.1).

end.description: app -> server. The user ended the measurement.

ready.description: server -> app after hello is accepted. The app waits 5 s for it (FE spec Q2).

started_at.description: Server session start (when the server received S1), UTC. The app dates and times today's record with it (ADR 0028).

ack.description: server -> app. Intervals up to last_sequence were written to Kafka. The app only shows it (no resending).

observation.description: server -> app, one per server batch (plan 0064: the server groups received intervals for about 3 s of server time, then judges every frame). Live status of the last judgeable frame of the batch. Score on screen = 100 x (1 - collapse_probability). 4.0 (2026-10-30) keeps only what the measuring screen uses; the processed position is in ack/progress last_sequence, the pause in progress.paused_reason, times in summary.

valid.description: true when the batch had at least one judgeable frame.

posture.description: good or bad for the last judgeable frame: the session policy threshold applied by the server. Momentary; alerts are still confirmed by decision/alert. null when not valid.

collapse_probability.description: Probability of bad posture for the same frame, 0 when not valid. Rule score until a trained model (ADR 0043); not calibrated.

progress.description: server -> app about every second. paused_reason: measuring is paused. Sessions under 5 min are stored too (DB V2.3, 10/14).

event.description: A confirmed judgement event. event_id starts at 1 per session. excluded_started/ended are for storage; the app only receives them.

decision.description: server -> app. Sent before the progress that includes it.

alert.description: server -> app only when an alert should be shown (the storage service already applied alerts off, hourly cap and stale events). The app does not filter.

stalled.description: server -> app. No judgement progress for 5 s.

closed.description: server -> app right before the server closes the connection.

ended_at.description: Server session end (same value as the stored ended_at), UTC, when the measurement session ended on this connection. Null if the connection closed before the session ended, or for registration (ADR 0028).

reason.description: day_changed: at KST midnight the previous session ended and was stored, but the server could not continue in a new session (session_rollover); the app starts a new measurement with S1.

session_rollover.description: server -> app at KST midnight when the server switch posegood.realtime.midnight-rollover is on (BE-6 1, plan B). The previous session ended at its last interval before midnight and was stored; this connection continues in a new session the server created with the same baseline, policy and alert setting (no S1). The app keeps sending sequence, start_ms and end_ms on the connection's axis; the server subtracts at_ms and its own sequence base. ack, progress and stalled keep the app's sequence numbers; summaries and decision event times after this message belong to the new session (midnight = 0). An interval that spans midnight, or a pre-midnight interval that arrives after this message, is only acked and belongs to no session.

ended_at.description: Server end of the previous session (same value as the stored ended_at, before midnight), UTC.

started_at.description: Server start of the new session: KST midnight, UTC.

at_ms.description: Where the new session starts on the app's connection time axis (ms from the first session's start).
